options.name: destination_datastore
options.description: The name of the destination datastore or the datastore cluster. If datastore cluster name is specified, we will find the Storage DRS recommended datastore in that cluster.

options.name: destination_host
options.description: The name of the destination host.

options.name: destination_resource_pool
options.description: Destination resource pool. If not provided, the destination host's parent's resource pool will be used.

options.name: destination_vcenter
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the destination VCenter.

options.name: destination_vcenter_password
options.description: The password of the destination VCenter.

options.name: destination_vcenter_port
options.description: The port to establish connection in the destination VCenter.

options.name: destination_vcenter_username
options.description: The username of the destination VCenter.

options.name: destination_vcenter_validate_certs
options.description: Parameter to indicate if certification validation needs to be done on destination VCenter.

options.name: destination_vm_folder
options.description: Destination folder, absolute path to deploy the cloned vm. Examples:    folder: vm    folder: ha-datacenter/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm

options.name: destination_vm_name
options.description: The name of the cloned VM.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: is_template
options.description: Specifies whether or not the new virtual machine should be marked as a template.

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the vm/template instance to manage if known, this is a unique identifier only within a single vCenter instance. This is required if O(name) or O(uuid) is not supplied.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine or template. This is a required parameter, if parameter O(uuid) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of Virtual Machine deployed. If set to V(present) and VM does not exists, then VM is created. If set to V(present) and VM exists, no action is taken. If set to V(poweredon) and VM does not exists, then VM is created with powered on state. If set to V(poweredon) and VM exists, no action is taken.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds. When the timeout is reached, the module will fail.

options.name: use_instance_uuid
options.description: Whether to use the VMware instance UUID rather than the BIOS UUID.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the vm/template instance to clone from, this is VMware's unique identifier. This is a required parameter, if parameter O(name) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
